app.name: Jadal
app.tagline: Fair canal water for every farm
app.description: Warabandi-style canal irrigation management with agentic AI
app.title: Farmer portal
app.subtitle: Registration, water turns and requests

home.title: Canal water shared by volume, not by hours.
home.subtitle: Jadal plans every farm's share in cubic metres, turns it into a turn time with simple physics, and phones each farmer in Telugu. A coordinator approves every step.
home.healthUnreachable: API unreachable — showing app shell only
home.farmerCardBody: Register, see your next turn and ask for extra water.
home.coordinatorCardBody: Verify farmers, approve plans and decide requests.
home.canalCardBody: See how far the water travels along the canal.
home.phoneCardBody: Try the Telugu voice call a farmer receives.
home.demoCardBody: Run the six-step walkthrough in under four minutes.
home.step4: Physics turns volume into turn time
home.loopLabel: Urgent requests, rain and harvest re-plan the schedule
home.principle: LLMs propose · the deterministic core computes · the coordinator approves

farmer.title: Farmer portal
farmer.body: Registration, plots, crop plans, quota balance and water requests will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
farmer.note: All volumes and schedules on this page will come from the API. This UI never computes water numbers.

coordinator.title: Coordinator portal
coordinator.body: Farmer verification, entitlement and roster approvals, and request decisions will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
coordinator.note: The coordinator approves every proposal. Agents suggest; the deterministic core computes; the coordinator decides.

canal.title: Canal view
canal.body: The canal map and release-window roster will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
canal.note: Flow, lag and turn durations are computed server-side and read from the API.

ui.error: Could not load the canal map.

phone.title: Simulated phone
phone.body: The in-browser Telugu call simulator will live here as the telephony fallback. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
phone.note: Voice transcripts and agent replies come from the API.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.body: Seeded-scenario reset, time travel and event replay will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
demo.note: Demo state is owned by the API; this page only sends demo commands and renders responses.

common.placeholderDetail: Full content arrives with a later sub-task. Shell, navigation, language and theme already work on this page.
common.notFoundBody: This route does not exist. Use the navigation above to continue.

footer.text: Jadal — deterministic volumes, coordinator-approved. UI displays API values only.

register.title: Season registration
register.intro: Register land, crops and sowing details. The coordinator verifies every registration.
register.name: Full name
register.cropsHint: Several crops per plot are allowed. Shares must add up to at most 100%.
register.successDetail: The coordinator will verify it before the season starts.
register.errPhone: Enter a valid phone number (digits, at least 10).
register.errArea: Plot area must be more than 0.
register.errCrop: Choose a crop for every row.
register.errSowing: Enter a valid sowing date (not in the future).
register.errShare: Each share must be between 1 and 100.
register.errShareSum: Shares must add up to at most 100%.

mywater.title: My water this week
mywater.intro: All figures come from the seasonal plan and the roster. This screen never estimates.

urgent.title: Raise a request
urgent.intro: Urgent water is deducted from your future quota. Buffer water comes from the shared pool and needs coordinator approval.
urgent.reasonHint: Example: rice flowering, hot spell, turn arrived short.
urgent.success: Request sent. The coordinator will decide.

buffer.title: Public buffer board
buffer.intro: Every buffer request and its decision is shown here so all farmers can see the shared pool is fair.

farmer.title: My water
farmer.lead: Register, check your next turn and ask for more water when a crop needs it.

coordinator.title: Coordinator console
coordinator.lead: Review what the AI proposed and approve each step before anything reaches a farmer.

canal.title: Canal water map
canal.lead: See how far the water travels and who gets how much along the way.

phone.title: Simulated phone call
phone.lead: The Telugu call a farmer receives, shown in the browser for when real telephony is unavailable.

demo.title: Demo walkthrough
demo.lead: Run the six-step story from registration to ledger in under four minutes.
